entries.title: Numbers 17:1
segments: And the LORD spoke to Moses saying,

entries.title: Numbers 17:2
segments: Speak to the sons of Israel, and take a rod from each of them for a father's house, of all their rulers, for their fathers' house, twelve rods. Write every man's name upon his rod.

entries.title: Numbers 17:3
segments: And you shall write Aaron's name upon the rod of Levi. For one rod [shall be] for the head of the house of their fathers.

entries.title: Numbers 17:4
segments: And you shall lay them up in the tabernacle of the congregation before the testimony, where I will meet with you.

entries.title: Numbers 17:5
segments: And it shall be, the rod of the man whom I shall choose shall blossom. And I will make to cease from Me the murmurings of the sons of Israel by which they murmur against you.

entries.title: Numbers 17:6
segments: And Moses spoke to the sons of Israel, and all their rulers gave to him a rod, for each ruler, one rod for each ruler, for their father's house, twelve rods. And the rod of Aaron [was] among their rods.

entries.title: Numbers 17:7
segments: And Moses laid up the rods before the LORD in the tabernacle of witness.

entries.title: Numbers 17:8
segments: And it happened on the next day Moses went into the tabernacle of witness. And behold! The rod of Aaron for the house of Levi had budded and had brought forth buds, and had bloomed blossoms, and had yielded almonds.

entries.title: Numbers 17:9
segments: And Moses brought out all the rods from before the LORD to all the sons of Israel. And they looked, and each one took his rod.

entries.title: Numbers 17:10
segments: And the LORD said to Moses, Bring Aaron's rod again before the testimony, to be kept as a token against the rebels. And you shall completely take away their murmurings from Me so that they do not die.

entries.title: Numbers 17:11
segments: And Moses did as the LORD commanded him, so he did.

entries.title: Numbers 17:12
segments: And the sons of Israel spoke to Moses saying, Behold, we die, we perish, we all perish.

entries.title: Numbers 17:13
segments: Whoever comes near the tabernacle of the LORD shall die. Shall we be consumed to die?
